text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, a press conference was held 
for the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's a ton of reporters! Ehehe, 
that's what I call expected for someone 
like me!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Many people have been watching your 
successes up until now with great 
interest, but how are you feeling about 
the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm totally in it to win it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the most amazing Umamusume 
ever, so first I've gotta become number 
one among my classmates!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Who do you consider to be your biggest 
rival?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"My rival? Isn't it obvious? It's none 
other than President Symboli Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of the Classics, the President's 
'Triple Crown Umamusume' title is famous, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So not just the Satsuki Sho, but I'll win 
the Derby and the Kikuka Sho too—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a Triple Crown Umamusume, 
just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That press conference was so exciting~! I 
had no idea we'd get that much attention, 
I'm stunned!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, thanks to that, I can't 
stop buzzing with excitement! The Classics 
are finally starting~!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I declared that I'd become a "Triple Crown 
Umamusume," so I've gotta train harder 
than ever!
choice_data_list: First is the first crown, the Satsuki Sho!
First is the first crown, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...So, I've got a suggestion. Mind hearing 
me out for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know how we ran alongside Air Groove 
before? I want to incorporate that into 
our training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course, opponents must have plenty of 
race experience! The stronger, the 
better~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like with Air Groove, I felt there 
was much to learn from an opponent who 
knows racing inside and out, so—
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it a try

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Trainer, you really get 
it~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll go look for an opponent 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew... Oguri really is fast, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, it's amazing that you, a 
Classic-tier racer, can push me this far.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right, right~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, ain't that an unusual pair. What're 
you two up to?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tamamo! Right on time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's do some tandem training! 
Come on, take your marks! Over here, over 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wh-Where are you going!? I have no 
idea what's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Classic races, Tokai Teio has 
been steadily improving her skills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that thought in mind, as I watched 
her training alongside her partner—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems her motivation heading into the 
Satsuki Sho is running high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio's been steadily improving ever since 
her debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mm. ...You are completely transformed from 
the days when you lost sight of your 
roots, consumed by blind yearning.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She, who once did nothing but clap in the 
"audience," has now descended onto the 
"stage" and is chasing after me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming to be a 'Triple Crown Umamusume', 
huh... Hehe. It truly is deeply moving."
choice_data_list:
You're really looking out for Teio, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"A world where every Umamusume can find 
happiness." To make that a reality, it is 
my mission to work myself to the bone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had intended to look out for them at 
first, so they wouldn't choose to hide in 
my shadow... and could aim without 
hesitation for the pinnacle everyone looks 
up to, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...'Surpass the Emperor and become the 
Teio.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The way Teio looked when she declared that 
to me... Those burning eyes and 
overflowing fighting spirit were seared 
into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —It won't come off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the "Emperor", I wish for her 
happiness. Yet even more so... for a far 
more selfish reason—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's waiting. ...For Teio.
choice_data_list: I will make sure she surpasses you.

I will make sure she surpasses you, for 
sure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu... But I won't let it go that easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf waiting at heights far 
above—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll run through the Classic races with 
Tokai Teio, and I'll definitely pass her!
